HDFC Bank Submits Names of Two CEO Candidates to RBI

HDFC Bank Ltd. said it has submitted the names of two candidates to the Reserve Bank of India for the position of managing director and chief executive officer.

The names were provided in order of preference, along with the proposed remuneration for a three-year term subject to RBI approval, the bank said in an exchange filing Saturday. It did not identify the candidates.
